title: comfy build validate --json data payload
description: Offline authoring and wire validation of the local spec, with optional advisory public-model lookup states.

folder_case_checked.description: Present only when the spec has models. False when no usable folder list was read from the builder (offline, without `--remote`; a read that failed or named no folder), so a case variant of a folder (`Loras` for `loras`) passed unchecked; the builder refuses it at the release.

workflow_coverage.description: Present only with `--workflow`, and only when the check passed: the builder compared the workflow at `path` with the LOCAL spec's definition (a local node counted as the upload a push makes of it) and found every custom node class installed. Any missing or unverified class, or a builder that could not check, is an error envelope instead (`build_workflow_nodes_missing`, `build_workflow_unverified`, `build_workflow_check_unavailable`).

format.description: The export dialect the builder read the file as, `api` or `ui`.

covered.description: Distinct custom node classes the definition installs.
